title: Hunts FH-048S: Compare pilot cohorts and choose expansions once a pilot has run

source.ref: Split from FH-048 (2026-11-16): the readiness review of the tree shipped; the comparison it asks for needs pilot data that does not exist.

detail: Requires a finished pilot: FH-019 (free Trail) at least, and FH-027 or FH-033 for any merchant or collective claim. Owed by Product and release, not by an agent, after the first pilot: (1) compare the pilot cohorts, the operational cost (hours, support load, venue time), the merchant benefit read from the merchant report, and the field risks actually seen, each with its source; (2) say which expansions are chosen and which are not; (3) have the owner or the database owner run the read-only legacy inventory queries in docs/hunts/EXPANSION-REVIEW.md on production and record the dated results, since legacy retirement is not recommended or scheduled until then. Done when: docs/hunts/EXPANSION-REVIEW.md carries a section whose heading is 'Pilot cohort results' followed by the date of the reading in brackets as YYYY-MM-DD, holding those results. No agent writes that section from anything but recorded pilot evidence, and no figure is estimated. Hunts switches stay OFF until each rung's own gate passes.
